title: disney fleece blanket
text: disney fleece blanket. Ooooo... SUPER soft - lightweight but warm fleece.... smaller size, which is perfect for my grandson who like a soft "ni-night" (code word for a lovey or woobie).  Washed up beautifully and will last as long as he needs it to.  Purchased for our first trip to Disneyland.
